hooks.command: root=$(git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && [ -f "$root/.claude/hooks/guard-bash.sh" ] && exec bash "$root/.claude/hooks/guard-bash.sh"; echo "guard-bash.sh not found from ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}, blocking every call. Start Claude Code inside the repo." >&2; exit 2

root=$(git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && [ -f "$root/.claude/hooks/format-file.sh" ] && exec bash "$root/.claude/hooks/format-file.sh"; echo "format-file.sh not found from ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}, so the file was not formatted. Start Claude Code inside the repo." >&2; exit 1
